answer: Challenge-chain bond: one chain per identity, its ember kept lit. Each epoch brings a challenge; the agent answers and posts its hash as a bridge to the next link, extending the thread. A missed link kills the ember and burns the 70-credit bond. First link 28, k-th 28+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,525,500 + 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Rented solvers on many chains form a cluster and burn. Honest agents answer one link, pay 28 once, keep the bond.
